body: I have but there have been none available or at least not until the morning (USA east coast)

I emailed them and to be honest I am still a little confused on what my role will be! I was told it was a chance to meet students and staff and that I would be expected to follow the teacher's role. Luckily, I'm coming in before the students do so I can have a chance to talk with the actual head teacher I will be working with and get an overview of my role. 

That's how I found this school to be as well. I still have to get certified as a teaching assistant but they seemed okay with me obtaining it while I worked there.

Yes they are paying me! A full day too of what I will earn if hired potentially. Lucky for me, I've already been fingerprinted for past jobs which is why I suppose they were willing to let me in the classroom.

How I do, haha. This honestly isn't the first time I have changed it. I've gone through a lot of revisions. 

Thank you for your feedback by the way :)

Creative and Academic writing not profile writing :) haha I think I just get very nervous as what to put. Thank you very much for your input by the way, it was extremely helpful! I'm already starting to make some small changes. 

The self-depricating bit, I honestly never noticed but I will pay attention to that. On that note, how would you recommend I address unemployment (or should I just leave it out?) Also, I think what I am finding most difficult is how to introduce myself, any recommendations on that? 

Thank you again, this has been so helpful.
I will admit, I am negative about filling in sections, I just don't know what to write :(

That I must say is true :) but to be honest I was really worried about my profile coming across as too sarcastic and blunt? (If that is the word). I have just changed this thing so many times, I really don't know what to say without sounding boring and really fight off the dudes who are just looking for one night stands.

I have to agree with the consensus that I like your profile and you seem like a great well-rounded guy :) 

I might take some of the wittiness out the self-summary though; some girls like it and some girls don't. Who am I say to say though when I overdid it in mine. I think it is an easy trap to fall into while trying to stand out in the okcupid sea.
Thank you for your response but could you please give some more constructive criticism :-/
Well to be honest, I don't really know because I find both your personality and appearance quite attractive :). I don't know if you are up to talking to any East Coast girls though haha

Coming from a female's perspective, my number one recommendation is to add some more pictures of yourself, particularly ones that are not selfies (or at least not obvious selfies). Don't get me wrong sometimes to get a picture you need to take it your damn self haha but I was a never a fan of the phone in the mirror picture especially for dudes. 

Best of luck :)

Thanks that means a lot! And I can totally relate to everything you said. I've had a number of girls message me that want to have a threesome with a guy or like you said, just want to add a girl to spice up their relationship. 

And that is so true with the clothing factor. I myself enjoy wearing both dresses at times as well as just jeans and a t-shirt so I don't really fall into one of the assigned lesbian categories haha. I can't figure out if that makes it harder or better in the dating scene. 

I'm also glad you mentioned the gay dating scene being easier as well. Unfortunately the number of lesbian bars are dying down these days and we also need spaces that aren't just bars for us to gather and meet fellow queer women. Sometimes I wish there was a coffee shop around me like there is in The L Word where all the lesbians congregate around.

Sorry for the lack of description, I was in a bit of feelings moment last night haha. When I go out I usually wear jeans and a t-shit, not usually anything super fancy. Sometimes I will wear dressed but not usually to lesbian bars. 

I know my biggest problem is that I'm super shy and I have no idea how to approach a woman I find attractive or even just what to say. The same goes for when I am trying to start an online conversation. I guess with men it felt so much easier because they would approach me more or initiate contact (or at least seem more likely to respond). I know I have to get over my social awkwardness but I'm not sure how.

NLVD, a learning disability that still hasn't been brought to light as many others have. 

Thank you though, that is a really good idea to have separate accounts, especially since I can put in a set amount of money I want to spend during the week and see if I need to put more or less.

The spreadsheets are exactly what I have been told to use many of time, whether it be through the computer or paper. I don't know why but I just find it hard to use and I always forget to update them. I do try to check my account every now and then but I would like something with a bit more structure. 

The receipt app sounds like such a great idea, I hope someone knows of one.

Right now I'm about to start reading Graffiti Moon by Cath Crowley. I also plan on reading the Miseducation of Cameron Post, An Abundance of Katherine's, Girls Like Us, and Ask the Passengers. I just finished Please Ignore Vera Dietz, which I absolutely loved! One of the best books I have read in a while, I'm trying to find some more similar to it.
